topic: https: not secure warning in chrome and google's https ranking signal
hook: Send this to a contractor whose website still says Not Secure.
caption:
Comment LEARN and I'll send you my free SEO starter guide. Follow for one SEO and web design lesson a day.

Send this to a contractor whose website still shows Not Secure.

Chrome puts that grey warning next to any page loaded over plain http. Now picture a homeowner in Phoenix typing her address into your quote form at 9 PM and seeing it right there in the bar. Yikes.

She's gone. You'd close that tab too.

Google also said back in 2014 that HTTPS is a small ranking signal. The fix? A free certificate. I'd just email your host today and ask them to switch it on.
